mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the membranes to the cochleas was most worthwhile: the result explained how movement bends hair-cell bundles and changes signals to nerve fibres.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hearing pathways was clear, but its result added little explanation beyond the picture description.

surprise.text: I expected the hair cells to combine directly with the membranes; the feedback showed that the cells had to go into the cochlear chambers first.

arbitrary.text: That required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary from the initial descriptions, although the compatibility feedback made the next step clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: building the route from air movement to nerve signals was satisfying, and the explanation of the cochlea made me curious about other senses.
